 r
ests

 a
 further

**
¶3:** This is the
 reason one
 degree of
 order was
 made to
 depend upon another:
 the
 five genera
 of falsity and evil were made
 to rest
 upon and
 be held within

 Wisdom proce
eding from the Divine Human —

 en
twined,

rained, and held captive within these
 containing forms of truth.
 Fals
ity has
 no power
 except

 within the order
 that
 wisdom
 imp
oses upon it.

**¶
4:** Within the interior
 degree dwell the five essential
 Divine
 Goods proceeding from the Divine Life
 itself
,
 for
 the entire structure
 of spiritual order is
 suspended from these
 goods
 and
 depends upon them for
 its coher
ence. (*
The fragmentary text appears

 subordin
ate degrees follow in sequence

**¶5:**

 And

 highest expanses of interior truth —

 Divine Good of the celestial kingdom
,
 dwelling

most life of all
 that
 exists. He
 is present throughout the whole of spiritual creation
 as its sust
aining center
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of darkness, males and females.
This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of Darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.

Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [upheld by them. And each one he]ard (?) him too, the oth[er zones that descend] after them.

And this is the one who came to [establish and sustain the fi]rmaments above [all,] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists and abides] within the [inmost midst] of the universe.
